summary: §1.2.3, p. 16, lines 258–259. [highlight] On the text: «requiring integration with government-wide PFM systems».
comment:
§1.2.3, p. 16, lines 258–259. [highlight] On the text: «requiring integration with government-wide PFM systems».
this is contradictory:
First part of sentence says: many flows within PFM, second part: these flows require integration with PFM ....
I suggest to say: 
"... that sit adjacent to both the health financing system and foundational payment DPIs, requiring alignment with health financing processes."
